content:
maria: heads up — nightly eval dashboard missed ~40 webhook deliveries last night, looks like the forwarder hit a rate limit and started backing off. anyone seen this pattern? :thinking:
eli: saw the spike in staging. forwarder logs show a lot of HTTP 429 sequences, and we currently just exponential-backoff without surfacing Retry-After to the dashboard.
kevin: is this only GH Actions -> reporter webhooks, or did buildkite notify paths also get throttled? could be PR gating bursts around 02:00 UTC.
sam: reporter metrics: delivery_success dropped from 99% -> 1% between 02:10-02:25. found headers: X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 and Retry-After: 120 on many responses.
maria: repro from a runner: ```bash
curl -i -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' https://reporter.internal/api/hooks/evals
```
response: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
also forwarder tail: 
``
[2026-03-18T02:11:04Z] WARN deliver attempt=3 status=429 retry_after=60
[2026-03-18T02:12:05Z] WARN deliver attempt=4 status=429 backoff=120
```
eli: we should surface "retry-after" in the dashboard and add an alert for "webhook delayed" so SRE/product knows when GA events are queued. also avoid immediate re-triggering from PR gating.
kevin: proposed changes: 1) forwarder must honor Retry-After rather than purely exponential backoff, 2) tag queued messages with target and backfill window, 3) add a concurrency cap per-webhook endpoint to avoid thundering replays.
sam: short-term mitigation: spread retries in the GH Actions step with jitter. e.g. add `sleep $((RANDOM % 30 + 30))` before webhook POST to avoid tight bursts.
maria: can someone open a quick PR against .github/workflows/evals-notify.yml to add jitter? i'll add a dashboard card for "pending webhook backfills" and a panel for Retry-After trends.
eli: assigning: @kevin for forwarder PR, @maria for dashboard. i'll add a synthetic flood test job to CI staging that simulates a reporter 429 for validation.
ci-bot: deploy status: staging-forwarder v1.12.3 rolled back at 2026-03-18T03:00Z due to alerts; tag created: forwarder-rollback-20260318
kevin: starting the PR now; will include Retry-After honoring, X-Forwarder-Retry header for observability, and per-endpoint concurrency cap. est 2-3 hrs.
maria: thanks — ping this thread when PR is up and i'll queue a backfill for last night's missing webhooks. :thumbsup:
